notes: τῆς precedes its noun πίστεως across the interposed prepositional phrase (rule 57), so under rule 31 it takes the discontinuous of the … that and ἐν carries the supplied copula.
ὅτι is left unrepresented because the ASV writes the clause with no complementizer at all; rule 43's test is the English word, not the reported-versus-recitative distinction.
